name: Yasushi Kamijo
original_name: カミジョウ ヤスシ
source: A kind and mysterious man. [spoiler]Kamijo is a popular performer on an erotic chat website, as well as a fan of tabletop games. He is later revealed to be the legendary first diver and the man behind the erotic chat performers known as 'Goddess'. With his job steadily becoming more dangerous and feelings of guilt caused by having to adjust normal people growing stronger, Kamijo started working on a plan to elope. Contracting 'Michiko' as a contract lodger and purchasing a retreat in the Kanto suburbs was all part of that plan. However, it did not work out, as Kamijo was ultimately found out by the Postal Federation - that, consequently, leading to his suicide.[/spoiler]
